nodes.title: How to use
widgets_values:
MODULAR V6 = V5 with the routing folded into four small nodes (same "first source with something wins" rules):
 Image Sources (main image + image 2: per-prompt first, then batch folder / fixed), Encoder Images (the three images the encoder gets; set swap_images_for HERE to swap image 1 and 2 for a shot type such as faces),
 Save Names (the scheduler's folder and file name when it is on, else the typed ones in the node), Prompt Builder (scheduler prompt, else prompt file by index, else the typed Edit Prompt; then the lighting line).
 Lighting is now a box on the Prompt Builder (no switch group): "none" leaves the prompt alone; lighting_by_shot picks a lighting per shot type or prompt number when the scheduler is on.
 The four progress readouts are one "Batch status" line. The scheduler's own swap setting is not used in V6 (leave swap_images_for empty there).
-----------------------------------------------------------------------
MODULAR V5 - EVERY PART IS A SWITCH-PANEL MODULE (top left). Everything new is OFF by default, so V5 works like V4 until you turn a module on.
TWO PANELS: "Switch Panel" MUTES a module (it is removed, and the switches fall back to the next source). "Switch Panel (bypass)" BYPASSES it instead (its inputs pass straight through). Use the first for normal on/off; use bypass only when you want a module skipped but still wired through. Do not use both on the same module.
NEW MODULE
 Source: Prompt By Index   one prompt file per run from a folder (Load Text by Index).
 Opt: Lighting   adds a lighting line (soft studio, warm golden hour, cool overcast, hard side light, dramatic low-key, backlit rim, candle or firelight, or your own text) to the end of the prompt, for ANY prompt source. Muted = the prompt passes through unchanged. With Source: Prompt Batch on, its lighting_by_shot box can pick a different lighting per shot type or prompt number (faces=soft studio, 09=hard side light); anything not listed uses the lighting box.
THE PROMPT BATCH SCHEDULER NOW DOES MORE (turn on Source: Prompt Batch, then set these in its own boxes; all are off by default):
 folder_template   where each prompt saves: {base}/_{id} (use {base}, {id}, {category}). File names come from filename_template.
 background   none / studio / custom: adds that background line to the end of every prompt from the scheduler (also saved in the picture data). For a typed prompt, put the background in the prompt itself.
 swap_images_for   a shot type such as faces: its prompts get image 2 as image 1 and image 1 as image 2.
 image_slot + images_folder / image_map   which slot (image 1, 2 or 3) gets the per-prompt image: the image named after the prompt number, or the one listed in the CSV.
 seed_mode / seed_base   repeatable = the seed comes from seed_base + prompt number + render number, so a render can be redone exactly; with the scheduler on it drives the sampler (otherwise the Seed node does).
 log_runs   adds a line per run to _batch_scheduler_log.csv in the prompts folder (time, prompt, render, seed, folder, size).
 megapixels_default / size_by_shot   the picture size for the Scale node: one default, plus optional per shot type or prompt (faces=1.0, 09=1.7). With the scheduler on, set the size here.
 contact_sheets   keeps numbered review sheets (thumbnails with file names) in a _Contact Sheets folder next to the prompt folders; they are one render behind.
WHO WINS WHEN SEVERAL ARE ON
 Prompt: scheduler list, then by index, then the typed Edit Prompt.   Images: per-prompt, then batch folder / Ref, then the fixed loader.   Names: scheduler, then typed.
-----------------------------------------------------------------------
QWEN 2.1 EDIT - MODULAR (v4)

One workflow for every Qwen 2.1 Edit job. Toggle groups with the Switch Panel (green = on). Every group named "Mode:", "Ref:", "Source:" or "Opt:" is a toggle. All off = FULL EDIT.

MODES (turn on at most one; if two are on the first wins: Outpaint > Inpaint > New Image > Full edit)
- FULL EDIT (all modes off): the whole image is re-rendered. Denoise 1.0 (lower = closer to the original).
- Mode: Masked Inpaint: right-click the main Load Image > Open in MaskEditor and paint the area. Only that area changes, the rest stays pixel-identical (Paste Mask Area Back). Grow 16. Denoise 1.0 (0.5 for subtle fixes).
- Mode: Outpaint: set the pad sides on the Pad node. Grow 96 hides the seam. Denoise 1.0. Check the Scaled Input preview.
- Mode: New Image: starts from an empty latent at the Resolution Selector size; the main image is only a reference. Denoise 1.0.

EXTRAS
- Ref: Image 2 / Ref: Image 3 = extra reference images (face, outfit, pose). Name them in the prompt ("the face from image 2").
- Opt: LoRA = Pixaroma LoRA loader in front of the model.
- Source: Batch Folder = feed images from a folder by index instead of the main Load Image (no mask, so no inpaint).

SOURCE: PROMPT BATCH (whole list) - NEW IN v4
Reads EVERY .txt prompt in a folder and renders each one the number of times you set (up to 100), one folder per prompt. Click Run once and walk away. It replaces the old one-prompt-per-run loader and overrides the Edit Prompt box while the group is on.
1. Turn on "Source: Prompt Batch" AND "Ref: Image 2" in the Switch Panel. The main Load Image is image 1 (e.g. a front/body reference) and Ref 2 is image 2 (e.g. a face reference).
2. In the Prompt Batch Scheduler node: prompts_folder = a folder of .txt files, one per prompt (sub-folders are fine; the sub-folder name is the shot type; the number at the end of the file name is the prompt number, `name_09.txt` = 09; a heading line like `name_09.` is dropped). output_base = where renders go inside the ComfyUI output folder; each prompt gets `<output_base>/_09/`. renders_per_prompt = renders EACH prompt gets (max 100). order = in order (all of prompt 1, then 2...) or rounds. targets (optional) = `faces=12` or `09=5` for different counts.
3. Prompts in a sub-folder called `faces` get image 1 and image 2 swapped automatically (the "Swap images for face prompts" switch turns that off).
4. Set Run count (next to Run) to prompts x renders (Settings > Batch count limit raises the 100 cap). Each run picks the next prompt that still needs renders, counts what is already in its folder, renders one image and saves it with the prompt, seed and LoRA info in the PNG. When every prompt is done, extra runs do nothing. Counts are remembered in `_batch_scheduler_state.json` in the prompts folder, so images you delete are NOT re-rendered (turn on recount_from_disk for one run to recount).
5. The group's readout shows the prompt number, which render of it this is, renders left in the whole batch, and the current prompt. With the group off, the Save node uses the fixed folder and file name boxes (bottom right) as before.

GOOD TO KNOW
- Image 1 is always the scaled main image (1.3 MP, steps of 16); the output size follows it.
- The negative prompt (in the Text Encode node) has NO effect at CFG 1. Raise CFG to use it (about 2x slower).
- Denoise is 1.0 on the KSampler for every mode. Lower it only if you want the result closer to the original.
- Do not run another batch into the same prompts folder at the same time (they share the counts file). Test first: Run count 2 on two prompts.

CHANGES FROM TALISAR'S MODULAR v2 (change back if you like)
1. NEW in v4: Prompt Batch Scheduler (whole list) replaces Load Prompt by Index, with a per-prompt output folder, face swap switch and progress readout. See above.
2. "Paste Mask Area Back" (inside the Masked Inpaint group) + "Final Image" switch: inpaint pastes only the masked pixels onto the scaled original, so the unmasked area is not changed by the VAE round trip.
3. Qwen model set to qwen_image_2.1_int8_convrot; switch the UNET Loader to your own file (bf16 etc.).
4. Seed is random on every run (it was saved as a fixed number).
5. Edit Prompt is core "String (Multiline)" instead of Comfyroll "CR Prompt Text", so Comfyroll is not needed.
6. KSampler denoise 0.85 -> 1.0. At 0.85 a "replace the background" prompt barely changed anything; at 1.0 it did, and the face stayed the same.
7. Removed the stale "widgets_values_named" blocks (ComfyUI only reads widgets_values).

Needs: the Prompt Batch Scheduler custom node (copy the ComfyUI-Prompt-Batch-Scheduler folder into custom_nodes and restart), Talisar Node Pack (Load Image by Index, Save Image Civitai), rgthree-comfy, ComfyUI-Pixaroma, ComfyUI 0.42 or newer. The detailer LoRA is optional and off by default.

OPTIONAL: A DIFFERENT IMAGE 3 FOR EACH PROMPT (with Source: Prompt Batch on)
In the Prompt Batch Scheduler node set images_folder (images named by prompt number, 09.png or anything_09.png) and/or image_map (a CSV with a header row: prompt = file name like name_17 or just 17, image = the file name; prompts may share one image). A prompt with a match sends that image to the encoder as image 3 (for example its room); a prompt without one uses the Ref: Image 3 loader if that group is on, otherwise no image 3. Leave both boxes empty to switch it off.
